{{Quote|Welcome, good people. Welcome. I am Koseyet, foreman of this mining camp.|Foreman Koseyet|<ref name="SWG:TTwH" />}}
'''Koseyet''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]] who lived on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was employed by [[Mensix Corp]] and was the [[Foreman/Legends|foreman]] of the [[Koseyet Mining Camp]].<ref name="SWG:TTwH" />
